description: This file defines Flask API endpoints for searching YouTube videos, downloading their audio as MP3 with range support, and serving audio files with HTTP Range headers. It includes functions for handling cookies, video info extraction, and file management, specifically tailored for a YouTube-to-MP3 conversion service.

classes.name: MethodView
classes.description: Base class for class-based views in Flask.

classes.name: Blueprint
classes.description: Flask-Smorest Blueprint for grouping related endpoints.

methods.name: _now_ts
methods.description: Returns current Unix timestamp as integer.

methods.name: _log
methods.description: Logs messages with specified level, using Flask's logger if available.

methods.name: _preview_cookies_content
methods.description: Inspects cookies.txt bytes to determine if in Netscape format.

methods.name: _preview_cookies_file
methods.description: Reads and inspects a cookies file for format and size.

methods.name: compress_audio
methods.description: Re-encodes and compresses MP3 files to specified bitrate.

methods.name: parse_duration_str
methods.description: Parses duration strings like '4:35' into seconds.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Yields file segments in chunks for partial content responses.

methods.name: parse_range_header
methods.description: Parses HTTP Range header into byte range tuple.

methods.name: make_partial_response
methods.description: Creates a 206 Partial Content response with byte range.

methods.name: make_entire_response
methods.description: Creates a response serving the entire MP3 file.

methods.name: delete_expired_files
methods.description: Deletes MP3 files older than retention period.
